stem: Each box of Seeds & Raisins contains $S$ grams of seeds and $R$ grams of raisins. The weight of a box, when empty, is $B$ grams. $S$, $R$ and $B$ are independent random variables, where $S \sim \text{N}(300, 45)$, $R \sim \text{N}(200, 25)$ and $B \sim \text{N}(15, 4)$. A full box of Seeds & Raisins is chosen at random.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that the total weight of the box and its contents is more than 500 grams.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability that the weight of seeds in the box is less than 1.4 times the weight of raisins in the box.
